notes.title: Update 1.6
notes.content:
Patch notes:

[olist]
[*] Achievements (kill enemies, lock count, evidence and equip count) should now work correctly
[*] Ghost won't lose track of the player 
[*] Added an extra set of portals near the end of the level, reducing the amount of backtracking during a run
[*] fix a crash in offline mode
[*] Cinematic can be skipped after the first time
[*] Dexterity will now slightly increase the player movement speed
[*] Dodge roll should now work correctly even when in aiming mode
[*] Reduce the amount of deaths needed to unlock some evidence
[*] Fix a potential problem with the Brute in case the player teleported to a special room while the enemy was on a wall and about to jump 
[*] Nerfed the boss damage and reduced punch speed
[*] Fix a rare bug that was causing the player to unlock the same card twice
[*] The input should now work correctly while in afk mode in the main menu
[*] Coins should now work fine in hard and very hard mode 
[*] Fixed a bug with the talking door, if you were to change dimension while the door was opening
[/olist]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1004370/ss_2ea6155dd134ca813fd1ccba5b4f7dc39be55567.1920x1080.jpg?t=1667828412[/img]

notes.title: New Update 1.3 Tapes Some Cracks Of Paper Cut Mansion! 🩹
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915747/e2631e9a30b238b259fe56887dc4f42ea625737a.jpg[/img]

Heya friends!

We have addressed a bunch of the issues that you reported in the [b]Paper Cut Mansion[/b] Steam Community. Thank you so much for sharing your feedback there, we really appreciate that. Please continue to provide us with alle the feedback you have, so that we can make the game the best experience possible. ❤️

[b]This is the change log of update 1.3:[/b]

[list][*] Improved performance (especially floor 6)
[*] The game will now start on the main menu, giving the chance to new players to access the settings (for example to change the language or the resolution) before the intro
[*] The intro can be skipped after has been completed once
[*] The howl in the intro should now track the player correctly
[*] Players can no longer accidentally get locked in the VIP room if leaving the game there
[*] Grace period for traps after you change dimension
[*] Occasionally some levels were having issues generating the navigation mesh, resulting in a very low frame rate and enemies unable to move. The problem is solved.[/list]
That's it for now, friends. Of course, we will keep you informed about all upcoming [b]Paper Cut Mansion[/b] updates here.

Spooky greetings out of the Mansion - see you inside!
Gabriele & The Paper Cut Mansion Team

notes.title: Patch 1.3
Behind The Cardboard #03: Facts, Figures & More About Paper Cut Mansion! 🎃
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915747/900df83085e733559beda3ab55705e686b0423a2.jpg[/img]

It's Wednesday, friends!

Do you know what that means?! Tomorrow is Thursday! Ha ha, yeah, you knew, right? And tomorrow is the day, that we at Space Lizard Studio have been working towards for five years! Incredible but true: [b]Paper Cut Mansion[/b] will be released tomorrow! Finally! ːsteamhappyː

Until now, we have been very busy polishing the game even more, but slowly we realize how little time is left until the release. And now, slowly but surely, the nervousness is building up... And that's why we can't get a straight sentence out today anyway. But we would like to take this opportunity to give you all the important facts and figures about [b]Paper Cut Mansion[/b] and its release tomorrow. So...

[b]Paper Cut Mansion:[/b]
[list][*] A roguelite horror set in a papercraft world
[*] Art style inspired by Tim Burton and Jim Henson
[*] 7 floors in the mansion
[*] 3 different dimensions per floor
[*] 6 songs with lyrics between the floors telling the story
[*] 50+ equipment items
[*] 60+ different enemies
[*] 15+ collectible evidence pieces
[*] 1 intermediate boss, 1 final boss
[*] 3 levels of difficulty
[*] 27 different endings
[*] Developed by 3 peeps in around 5 years
[*] Will release October 27 5pm CEST/3pm UTC/8am PDT[/list]
There is more in the game of course, but we don't want to spoil too much. Tomorrow you can check out for yourselves what there is to do and to discover in the spooky floors and dimensions of [b]Paper Cut Mansion[/b].

Till tomorrow and cake care everyone!
Gabriele & The Paper Cut Mansion Team

notes.title: Paper Cut Mansion Supports Razer Chroma, Sweepstakes Live! 🐍
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915747/e9179838501ec668f4d323e6662d4185ebf84ec8.jpg[/img]

Halloween is close, friends!

And Halloween is not only the time of spooky Steam Scream Fest, it's also the time of dim candlelight and the glowing-grinning grimaces of Jack O'Lantern! And - as the release is only two days away - it's also the right time of creepy Chroma RGB illumination in [b]Paper Cut Mansion[/b]!

At RazerCon 2022 on October 15 we officially announced the [b]Paper Cut Mansion[/b] release date plus Razer Chroma support. So, in the case you own Razer Chroma peripherals (or you win them - more about that later), you will notice very quickly after launching the game that the RGB Illumination responds to it. "Neat, but why should I need that" you think? Fair enough! But let me explain why in our opinion, a spooky RGB illumination is a perfect fit for our spooky papercraft roguelite.

[previewyoutube=nCNQp9_6Bfk;full][/previewyoutube]
The core of [b]Paper Cut Mansion[/b] is - of course - the namesake mansion. There you puzzle, fight and investigate the various floors. Each floor has a different theme and contains portals that lead you to alternate versions of the same location. And each of the three dimensions has a base color: The NeonCortex Dimension is purple, the Reptilian Complex is red and the Limbic System Dimension is blue.

And so, of course, it's a simple one, that the color mood of the game can be perfectly extended beyond the monitor by illuminating your Chroma peripherals: mouse, mouse pad, headset and keyboard. And in case you use LED strips or compatible ambient lights, you can immerse the whole room in the threatening red of the Reptilian Complex Dimension or the icy blue of the Limbic System Dimension. This has a pretty cool (LOL) effect!

Atmospheric illumination? Check! Plus we experimented with more different Chroma effects that are triggered by certain actions in the game. But I don't want to tell you too much about it here. Finally, it won't be long until Paper Cut Mansion will be available, then you can see the Chroma support for yourself.

And - to celebrate the Paper Cut Mansion release and the Chroma support - we've started a sweepstakes that you can participate in AS OF NOW! We've teamed up with Razer to offer you these awesome prizes:

[list][*] 1x Razer Cynosa V2 Gaming Keyboard
[*] 1x Razer Kraken V3 Gaming Headset
[*] 1x Razer Basilisk V3 Gaming Mouse
[*] 1x Razer Firefly V2 Gaming Mouse Pad
[*] 10x Paper Cut Mansion Steam Key[/list]
[url=https://gleam.io/pb9WW/win-razer-chroma-equipment-paper-cut-mansion][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915747/ec419a022fc8c9109ac5029d4e8ad60cffc66a5c.jpg[/img][/url]

How to take part? Click [url=https://gleam.io/pb9WW/win-razer-chroma-equipment-paper-cut-mansion][b]HERE[/b][/url] or on the artwork above to enter our sweepstakes page on Gleam and follow the instructions there!

Good luck everyone. We keep our fingers crossed for you!
Gabriele & The Paper Cut Mansion Team
